description_en: Modifies the IP whitelists for a LindormV2 instance
description_zh: 设置LindormV2实例的访问白名单
kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb update-lindorm-v2-white-ip-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ld-2ze5ipz9zx1e40000 --white-ip-group-list GroupName=user001 WhiteIpList=192.168.0.X/24 --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLindormV2WhiteIpList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the GetLindormV2InstanceList operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The name of the IP whitelist group
fields.name: group_name

fields.help_en:
The IP addresses to add to the IP whitelist.

The value 127.0.0.1 denies access from all IP addresses. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 allows all IP addresses in that range to access the Lindorm instance. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks
fields.help_zh:
需要设置的白名单IP地址。
127.0.0.1表示禁止所有地址访问，例如192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.X的IP地址访问该Lindorm实例。多个白名单用半角逗号（,）分隔
fields.name: white_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The list of IP whitelist groups
parameters.name: white_ip_group_list
